articles.summary: NEW YORK, Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Ready Capital Corporation (“Ready Capital” or the “Company”) (NYSE: RC) today announced that its Board of Directors (the “Board”) has approved a reverse stock split of Ready Capital’s outstanding shares of common stock at a ratio of one-for-ten (the “Reverse Stock Split”). One-for-Ten Reverse Stock Split The Reverse Stock Split is scheduled to take effect at 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time on December 7, 2026 (the "Effective Time"). At the Effective Time, every ten issued and outstanding shares of common stock of the Company will be combined into one share of common stock of the Company. The Board also approved a reduction of the Company’s authorized shares of common stock from 500,000,000 to 50,000,000, effective immediately following the Effective Time.
